## Change summary

Describe the user-visible change and the reason for the update.

## Required documentation / validation

- [ ] **README.md updated in this pull request** with new behavior, version and limitations.
- [ ] README release-history section matches the version in package.json.
- [ ] Documented research-only versus learner-visible behavior accurately (where relevant).
- [ ] Relevant unit tests, browser regressions and musical benchmark checks run or explicitly explained.
- [ ] Owner-provided 14 transparent PNG hand assets preserved without retouching or regeneration (when applicable).

The Pull Request CI refuses a PR without a README.md change.
